change.title: stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields

source.quote: Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo runs stripe-node 17.5.0 with apiVersion pinned to 2024-12-18.acacia. Nothing breaks today because the pinned version keeps working, but every listed stripe-node major (19–23) and the dahlia/endive API majors apply once the SDK is moved. Upgrading to stripe-node 23 is one coherent move: bump the package, change the apiVersion pin to 2026-09-30.endive, and fix what breaks. The confirmed edits are: (1) remove payment_method_types from checkout.sessions.create (endive returns 400); (2) handle the basil Subscription/Invoice shape changes in the webhook handler (current_period_end moved to items, invoice.subscription moved under parent) if the webhook reads them; (3) ensure `new Stripe()` construction. The agent should also verify webhook event typing and that ui_mode is unused, and confirm the Node runtime version.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version (api-version): New API major 2026-09-30.endive carries breaking changes; pin it via Stripe-Version or upgrade SDKs (node 23, python 16, go v87), effective 2026-09-30. stripe-node 23 pins 2026-09-30.endive. The apiVersion literal in lib/stripe.ts:4 must move to it as part of the same bump.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "As the first version in the Endive release, `2026-09-30.endive` introduces both breaking changes and new features."
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout (field-removed): payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions create, and paymentMethodTypes option removed from Elements deferred intents (Stripe.js), effective 2026-09-30. app/api/stripe/route.ts:35 passes payment_method_types to checkout.sessions.create. On endive this returns a 400, so the bump PR must drop the param and rely on dynamic payment methods.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "We [removed the `payment_method_types` parameter from Checkout Sessions]"
- stripe:2026-03-25-dahlia-api-version (api-version): API major 2026-03-25.dahlia with breaking changes (Checkout ui_mode enum values, events_from on event destinations, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js method removals), effective 2026-03-25. Dahlia is an intermediate API major crossed when going from acacia to endive. Its breaking changes are handled within the same version bump.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features"
- stripe:2026-03-25-checkout-ui-mode-enum (field-renamed): Checkout Session ui_mode enum values updated (Checkout Sessions and Payment Links), effective 2026-03-25. Dahlia renames the Checkout ui_mode enum values. The repo's checkout.sessions.create call is not recorded as setting ui_mode, so it likely needs no edit. The migration agent should verify that no ui_mode is set or read.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "Updates Checkout Session UI mode enum values"
- stripe:node-22-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 22.0.0: Stripe is a true ES6 class (use new Stripe()), types reworked, per-request host override removed, effective 2026-04-02. This is an intermediate stripe-node major crossed by the bump. It requires `new Stripe()` (check lib/stripe.ts) and removes per-request host override (not used).
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Stripe import is now a true ES6 class. Use `new Stripe()` to create a StripeClient instead of calling it:"
- stripe:node-21-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 21.0.0: pins 2026-03-25.dahlia, drops Node 16, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, wrong webhook parsing method throws, effective 2026-03-25. This is an intermediate stripe-node major. It pins dahlia, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, and using the wrong webhook parsing method now throws. constructEvent for snapshot events stays valid; verify this at app/api/webhook/route.ts:15.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "All `decimal_string` fields changed type from `string` to `Stripe.Decimal` in both request params and response objects."
- stripe:node-20-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 20.0.0: pins 2025-11-17.clover; v2 array params use indexed serialization (may break mock-server tests), effective 2025-11-18. This is an intermediate stripe-node major. It pins clover and changes v2 array serialization; the repo has no v2 calls and no mock-server tests seen.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "This may break any unit tests that expect the latter behavior when setting up a mock server."
- stripe:node-19-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 19.0.0: pins 2025-09-30.clover; parseThinEvent renamed parseEventNotification, v2 delete returns V2DeletedObject, v2 nullable props optional; 19.x deprecated (Files API timeout bug), effective 2025-09-30. This is an intermediate stripe-node major. It renames parseThinEvent and changes v2 delete and nullable typing, none of which the repo uses. It also pins clover, which is crossed in the same bump.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Rename function `StripeClient.parseThinEvent` to `StripeClient.parseEventNotification` and remove the `Stripe.ThinEvent` interface."
- stripe:runtime-go-1-24-drop (sdk-major): stripe-go will drop Go 1.24 in March 2027 major; Python 3.9 (stripe-python) March 2027; Node 20 (stripe-node) September 2027, effective 2027-03. The notice states stripe-node drops Node 20 in its September 2027 major. This is a runtime-support note for the same SDK upgrade; the agent should confirm the deploy runtime (Vercel/Node) is Node 22+ when bumping.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/versioning.md
  "We’ll drop support for it in the September 2027 major release."

callSites.why: The apiVersion is pinned to 2024-12-18.acacia. With stripe-node 23 the TypeScript type only accepts 2026-09-30.endive, so the pin must change.
checkout.sessions.create passes payment_method_types, which is removed on endive (400). It must be dropped.
billingPortal.sessions.create uses customer and return_url, which are unchanged. Re-verify the types after the bump.
webhooks.constructEvent still exists, but 21.0.0 throws if the wrong parsing method is used. Confirm that snapshot events are parsed with constructEvent and that the event typing still compiles.

subscriptions.retrieve: from 2025-03-31.basil onward, current_period_end/current_period_start moved from Subscription to subscription items. Code storing the period end must read items.data[0].current_period_end.

This is the same Subscription response-shape change as line 27. If this branch handles invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.subscription moved to invoice.parent.subscription_details.subscription in basil.

record.prBody:
## stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields [Verified]

### Change

Bumped stripe to 23.0.0 via npm. In lib/stripe.ts, set apiVersion to 2026-09-30.endive; the client already used `new Stripe()`. In app/api/stripe/route.ts, removed payment_method_types from checkout.sessions.create. In app/api/webhook/route.ts, the period end now comes from subscription.items.data[0].current_period_end. The invoice.payment_succeeded handler now reads the subscription id from invoice.parent.subscription_details.subscription, returns 200 if it is missing, and casts the event object to Stripe.Invoice. Added scripts/check-stripe-migration.js as the proof test. The repo uses no ui_mode, constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType, V2 list calls or parseThinEvent.

Files touched:
- `app/api/stripe/route.ts`
- `app/api/webhook/route.ts`
- `lib/stripe.ts`
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `scripts/check-stripe-migration.js`

### Why

stripe-node 23 pins the endive API version. Endive removes Checkout payment_method_types, and basil and later moved current_period_end to subscription items and the invoice's subscription reference under parent. The old code would have failed type checks or returned 400s.

> Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| stripe-migration | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- stripe-migration, added by the agent: `export DATABASE_URL='postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/db' DIRECT_URL='postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/db' STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_placeholder' STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET='whsec_placeholder' NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY='[redacted]' CLERK_SECRET_KEY='sk_test_placeholder' OPENAI_API_KEY='placeholder' COHERE_API_KEY='placeholder' PINECONE_API_KEY='placeholder' REPLICATE_API_TOKEN='placeholder' UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL='https://placeholder.upstash.io' UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN='placeholder' NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL='http://localhost:3000'; node scripts/check-stripe-migration.js` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider tool calls recorded by the harness:
- `stripe__stripe_check_params`: pass

The agent's validator claims (not proof; graded against the recorded calls):
- stripe__stripe_check_params: pass (POST /v1/checkout/sessions params checked against the endive spec: no problems.)

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The repo's postinstall hook (prisma generate) was skipped; @prisma/client types and the generated client are needed for tsc and next build.); it exited 0.
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The postinstall hook (prisma generate) did not run with install scripts off, and the code imports the generated Prisma client.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, STRIPE_API_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, CLERK_SECRET_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, COHERE_API_KEY, PINECONE_API_KEY, REPLICATE_API_TOKEN, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.

Test of this change: `stripe-migration`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- The proof test is a static source check plus a check of the installed stripe version, not a runtime test with a mocked Stripe client.
- Deploy runtime must be Node >=20, as stripe 23 requires; not checked.
- The dashboard webhook endpoint API version should be aligned to endive; not done here.

### Behaviour changes

- Checkout now uses dynamic payment methods from dashboard settings instead of card only, so customers may see other methods.
- invoice.payment_succeeded now returns 200 early when the invoice has no subscription reference, where before it would have called retrieve with undefined.
- items.data[0] is assumed to be the single subscription item.
- The existing metadata.userId check still runs before the invoice branch, and invoice events never reach that check (the checkout branch is separate), so behaviour there is unchanged.
- Stripe API responses are now at the endive shape. Live calls were not made.

preparation.reasoning:
The only setup hook is postinstall running prisma generate, which was skipped because install scripts are off. The Prisma schema reads DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL through env(), so placeholders are provided to let generate and the build load. No migration is run since that would need a real database.
The build fails at page data collection for /api/webhook with Stripe's 'Neither apiKey nor config.authenticator provided' error. The Stripe client is constructed at module load with an empty key, so the build needs a placeholder STRIPE_API_KEY. I added placeholders for the other service keys the app likely reads at load (Clerk, OpenAI, Cohere, Pinecone, Replicate, Upstash). The Prisma client also has to be generated, since postinstall was skipped.

review.summary:
The quoted change, removal of `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()`, does not affect this repo. Only `webhooks.constructEvent` is used, and that is unchanged. The real work is the jump from stripe 17 (2024-12-18.acacia) to 23 (2026-09-30.endive), which crosses the basil-era shape changes. The diff handles the two that matter:
- `subscription.current_period_end` becomes `items.data[0].current_period_end`.
- The invoice's subscription now comes from `invoice.parent.subscription_details`.
It also fixes a latent bug: the old code cast the invoice to a Checkout.Session. Typecheck passing against v23 types gives some confidence in the field paths. However, the PR makes one checkout behaviour change that the upgrade does not force. The webhook path depends on the dashboard endpoint's API version, which no check exercises. The added stripe-migration script only greps for the agent's own edits. I can't confirm the version string `2026-09-30.endive` from memory; typecheck passing suggests the v23 SDK types accept it. 'verified' overstates what was proven for the webhook and payment flows.

concerns.issue: Line 38 removes `payment_method_types: ["card"]`. This switches Checkout to dashboard-configured dynamic payment methods, so Link, wallets and bank debits may appear for subscriptions. The SDK upgrade does not require this, and it is a product and billing behaviour change that should be a deliberate choice.

Webhook event payloads are rendered at the webhook endpoint's configured API version, not the SDK's `apiVersion`. If the endpoint is still on acacia or older, `invoice.parent` is absent and `subscriptionId` is undefined. The new early `return 200` then silently drops every renewal, so `stripeCurrentPeriodEnd` never advances and users lose Pro after the first period. Nothing errors.
Silently returning 200 when no subscription id is found hides failures from Stripe's retry and alerting. Consider logging this case at minimum.
`items.data[0].current_period_end` assumes a single-item subscription. That is fine for this app's one-price checkout, but it is an implicit assumption.
stripe 23 requires Node >=20 (per package-lock engines). The deploy runtime (e.g. Vercel project Node version) must be 20+. The local devDependency `@types/node ^20` is consistent with this.

The 'stripe-migration' check is a string-match assertion of the agent's own edits, not a behavioural test. Its pass proves the edits exist, not that checkout, webhook signature verification or invoice handling work at runtime. No live call or webhook fixture was exercised, so a 'verified' grade isn't supported for the webhook path. The script is also probably not something to commit to the repo.

checkFirst: In the Stripe dashboard, check the API version of the webhook endpoint pointing at /api/webhook. Bump it to match 2026-09-30.endive, or confirm invoice payloads include `parent.subscription_details`.
Decide whether dropping `payment_method_types: ["card"]` is intended; if not, restore it.
Replay `checkout.session.completed` and `invoice.payment_succeeded` with `stripe trigger` / `stripe listen` against a test env and confirm `userSubscription` rows are created and updated.
Confirm `2026-09-30.endive` matches the `apiVersion` type in node_modules/stripe for v23.0.0 and the changelog.
Confirm the production Node runtime is >=20.
